title: Bootstrap and drain proven on three fresh public repositories (php, npm, py)
body:
Why: the three orphan-base rows were tuned against eight defects and came from operator repos (d-fe0823); KRN needs mechanism proof on untuned, public-safe repos while t-d19z692 waits for private repos (d-174575).
Outcome: three small permissively licensed public GitHub repos (one php, one npm, one python; no test command at the base preferred; under ~5k LOC) cloned as scratch copies under /mnt/storage/tmp/krn-outside-public/{php,npm,py} with UPSTREAM.json {url, license} and the history shape scripts/outside-acceptance.ts expects; then node scripts/outside-acceptance.ts --scratch /mnt/storage/tmp/krn-outside-public per stack: adopt 0, first-test PR merged, drain 0 with zero lead turns; every failure is a KRN defect fixed with a regression test in its own PR (Refs this task).
Proof: three new rows in .krn/runs/outside/summary.txt with drain exit 0 and all PRs merged; outside/* branches deleted afterwards. Paid: about nine Sonnet sessions.
